name: MonarchAiConfidenceMeter
title: AiConfidenceMeter
wrapsNative: HStack in a Capsule (badge), or Capsule track and fill in a GeometryReader (bar)
summary: How sure the AI is about a value, as low, medium or high, always in words: a compact badge or a labelled bar.
whenToUse: Beside a value the AI extracted or generated, so people know when to check it.
whenNotToUse: For task progress use ProgressView with the monarchLinear style. For a status that is not a confidence use MonarchBadge.
api: init(value: Double, explanation: String? = nil, variant: MonarchAiConfidenceMeterVariant = .badge, size: MonarchAiConfidenceMeterSize = .md, lowThreshold: Double = 0.6, highThreshold: Double = 0.85, showsValue: Bool? = nil, levelLabel: String? = nil, meterLabel: String? = nil, valueText: ((String, String) -> String)? = nil)
enum MonarchAiConfidenceLevel { case low, medium, high; static func level(for value: Double, lowThreshold: Double = 0.6, highThreshold: Double = 0.85) -> MonarchAiConfidenceLevel }

options.name: value
options.description: The confidence from 0 to 1. Values outside the range are clamped; not-a-number counts as 0.

options.name: explanation
options.description: Why the model is or is not confident. Shown under the bar; for the badge it is only the VoiceOver hint.

options.name: variant
options.description: A compact pill, or a labelled bar.

options.name: size
options.description: sm has tighter padding, a thinner track and caption text in the bar.

options.name: lowThreshold
options.description: The edge under which confidence is low.

options.name: highThreshold
options.description: The edge from which confidence is high.

options.name: showsValue
options.description: Whether to show the percentage. By default only the bar shows it.

options.name: levelLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in label of the band.

options.name: meterLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Confidence" spoken name of the bar.

options.name: valueText
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken value. Receives the band label and the percentage.

states.name: low
states.description: "Needs check" with a warning triangle, in the low-confidence colour on a danger-subtle pill.

states.name: medium
states.description: "Medium confidence" with a half-filled circle, in the medium-confidence colour on a warning-subtle pill.

states.name: high
states.description: "High confidence" with a check symbol, in the high-confidence colour on a success-subtle pill.

appearance: The badge is a capsule with a subtle status fill and border and the confidence colour for the icon and label. The bar is a muted capsule track filled with the confidence colour of the band.
platformNotes: The web shows the badge's explanation in a tooltip on hover and focus; iOS has no tooltip on touch, so for the badge the explanation reaches only VoiceOver. Use the bar when sighted people must read it. The web's small badge uses an 11-point size; iOS uses the caption role at both sizes and tightens the padding.
accessibility: The meter is one element. The badge reads "Needs check, 42% confidence"; the bar has the label "Confidence" and that text as its value.
The explanation is the accessibility hint.
The band is always in words and has its own icon, not colour alone.
The percentage is formatted in the user's locale.
Text scales with Dynamic Type. The meter is not interactive.
The fill of the bar starts at the leading edge, so it mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: A value exactly on the low threshold is medium; exactly on the high threshold is high.
If lowThreshold is above highThreshold there is no medium band.
A change of value animates the fill unless Reduce Motion is on.
